content: macOS Seatbelt via sandbox-exec: deprecated-but-functional CLI over private libsandbox APIs; SBPL profile language undocumented (reverse-engineered from /System/Library/Sandbox/Profiles); deny default requires exhaustive allowlisting (mach-lookup, ipc-posix-shm, dyld cache) and profiles drift across macOS releases; denial logging only via log stream; treat as best-effort containment not a security boundary. Codex CLI and Claude Code both ship sandbox-exec wrappers with generated .sb profiles (read-only FS, write to workspace+home config, deny network*).
